definitions.explanation: The ability to hold a conversation — typically referring to skill in a foreign language, but also used for the social skill of conversing well with others. Commonly discussed in language study and communication training.

examples.japanese: {会話力|かいわりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧。
⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{会話力|かいわりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I'm not confident in my English conversation skills.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{会話力|かいわりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: My Japanese conversation skills improved dramatically through studying abroad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{専門知識|せんもんちしき}→専門知識：19008_senmonchishiki⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧{会話力|かいわりょく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: To succeed at work, conversational ability is also important, not just specialized knowledge.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧ ('conversation') and the suffix {力|りょく} ('ability; power'). The {力|りょく} suffix is highly productive and attaches to many nouns to form 'ability' words: {英語力|えいごりょく} ('English ability'), ⟦{読解力|どっかいりょく}→読解力：09290_dokkairyoku⟧ ('reading comprehension'), ⟦{集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}→集中力：17614_shuuchuuryoku⟧ ('concentration'), ⟦{表現力|ひょうげんりょく}→表現力：21315_hyougenryoku⟧ ('expressive ability').

USAGE:
Most often used in the context of foreign-language study, especially in expressions like ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{会話力|かいわりょく} or ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{会話力|かいわりょく}. Can also refer to the social/interpersonal skill of carrying a conversation, particularly in business training contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会話力|かいわりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to improve conversational ability
- {会話力|かいわりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧: to extend/grow one's conversational ability
- {会話力|かいわりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧: to acquire conversational skills
- {会話力|かいわりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have good conversational ability
- {会話力|かいわりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: to lack conversational ability
- {会話力|かいわりょく}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧: conversation ability test

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{語学力|ごがくりょく}→語学力：29443_gogakuryoku⟧: language ability — broader; covers reading, writing, speaking, listening
- {英語力|えいごりょく}: English ability — specifically one language, across all four skills
- ⟦コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}→コミュニケーション能力：25825_komyunikeeshonnouryoku⟧: communication skills — even broader, includes non-verbal and written communication
- ⟦{話|はな}し{方|かた}→話し方：15767_hanashikata⟧: way of speaking — delivery and style, not skill level
- ⟦{対話力|たいわりょく}→対話力：24852_taiwaryoku⟧: dialogue skills — more formal, emphasizes two-way exchange
